settings.headline: Orbitly system status
settings.subtitle: Live health for every part of Orbitly. Day-by-day history for the last 90 days.

incidents.title: Delayed email notifications
incidents.body: A mail provider slowdown delayed some notification emails by up to 40 minutes. Nothing was lost; every email was delivered.

incidents.title: Slow timeline loading for large projects
incidents.body: Projects with more than 2,000 tasks loaded slowly for about an hour after a release. We rolled back, fixed the query and shipped again the next day.

incidents.title: Mobile sync paused
incidents.body: The iOS and Android apps stopped syncing for 18 minutes during database maintenance. Changes made offline synced automatically afterwards.
